candidates.explanation: The provider defaults to AuthProvidersEnum.google when createUserDto.provider is not supplied. Email registration (AuthService.register) calls usersService.create without a provider, so the new user is stored with provider 'google'. AuthService.validateLogin then sees user.provider !== 'email' and throws 422 needLoginViaProvider:google.
register() creates the user from ...dto, role and status, but never sets provider: AuthProvidersEnum.email. It therefore relies on the wrong default in UsersService.create.

fix.description: Change the default provider to AuthProvidersEnum.email (createUserDto.provider ?? AuthProvidersEnum.email). Optionally also pass provider: AuthProvidersEnum.email explicitly in AuthService.register.
